answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a meadow header. Producing 72 answers an epoch therefore burns 81 real forward passes, and the ridge record lets any auditor recompute the check. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a willow spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
